authority: Explicit user prospective response and cross-sectional semantics instruction 2026-10-07

common_domain_missingness.delayed: unavailable for feature/B if original availability>t
common_domain_missingness.missing: unavailable; no older-hour fallback or forward-fill
common_domain_missingness.no_original_availability_evidence: causal availability UNKNOWN, never PASS by inventing available_at=close_time
common_domain_missingness.tick_volume: reported nonnegative integer where B/feature requires it

cross_sectional_exact_semantics.L_j: Exact hourly price location coordinate of immutable B_j(t)
cross_sectional_exact_semantics.availability: Every peer required at feature entry has completed immutable B and certified availability<=t; no forward fill
cross_sectional_exact_semantics.cohort_authority: Frozen accepted 1575 eligible study identities grouped by BROKER_NATIVE_CONTEXT; immutable study cohort, no claim of dynamic historical economic linkage
cross_sectional_exact_semantics.fresh_peer_set: P_i(t)={j in same frozen context,j!=i, immutable B_j(t) available causally}. Freeze this set at feature timestamp t; never add response-selected identities.
cross_sectional_exact_semantics.mechanism: Contemporaneous within-cohort price-location dispersion conditions next-hour peer adjustment
cross_sectional_exact_semantics.missingness: Own B/feature and own future response valid, |P_i(t)|>=2 and |P_i,h^R|>=2. No filling/imputation, no substitutions outside frozen P_i(t). Retain peer set sizes and missingness reasons.
cross_sectional_exact_semantics.nonredundancy_domain_law: Hold own B fixed; vary legal fresh peer hourly locations in same study context to vary Phi. Only structural nonredundancy, no predictive claim
cross_sectional_exact_semantics.response_role: Own relative-to-contemporaneous-peer adjustment, as explicit new user authority
cross_sectional_exact_semantics.valid_response_peer_set: P_i,h^R subset of frozen P_i(t): complete h-bar future window with valid finite OHLC and positive close endpoints. Invalid responses are missing, never zero.

BROKER_NATIVE_ACTIVITY_STATE.missingness: Own baseline/feature and all declared future window bars required; no fill/imputation

MULTISCALE_PRICE_STATE.missingness: Own baseline/feature and all declared future window bars required; no fill/imputation

REGIME_AND_STRUCTURAL_BREAK_STATE.D0: 12 per-bar price locations from H0=[t-3600,t), as inherited
REGIME_AND_STRUCTURAL_BREAK_STATE.Dplus1: 12 per-bar price locations from immediately next completed UTC hour [t,t+3600)
REGIME_AND_STRUCTURAL_BREAK_STATE.horizon_contraction: 1 M5 cannot define a full nonoverlapping future hour distribution; prospective mechanism-specific contraction, not performance-based horizon selection
REGIME_AND_STRUCTURAL_BREAK_STATE.missingness: Any required future bar missing, duplicate or invalid/nonfinite OHLC => RESPONSE_UNAVAILABLE; no imputation
REGIME_AND_STRUCTURAL_BREAK_STATE.role: State persistence information only; separate downstream economic incremental certification
REGIME_AND_STRUCTURAL_BREAK_STATE.schedule_reason: Only at UTC hour boundary does next nonoverlapping UTC hour [h,h+3600) equal a wholly future twelve-M5 response window starting at entry t. Other M5 decision times are not in this candidate response schedule; feature map unchanged.

VOLATILITY_AND_REALIZED_VARIANCE_STATE.missingness: Any required future bar missing, duplicate, invalid/nonfinite or nonpositive OPEN/CLOSE => RESPONSE_UNAVAILABLE; no imputation
VOLATILITY_AND_REALIZED_VARIANCE_STATE.positive_prices: Every future OPEN and CLOSE must be >0
VOLATILITY_AND_REALIZED_VARIANCE_STATE.role: Variation information only; separate downstream economic incremental certification before trading promotion

time_index_law.C_i(t): close of bar [t-300,t), latest fully completed M5
time_index_law.features: Inherited exact feature maps are evaluated at the same t; no changing their anchors
time_index_law.original_availability: Required feature/B records completed and authentic original availability<=t. Acquisition/receipt time is not substituted for historical availability.
